title: Optimize Console: Safe-Apply Workflow for Batching & KV-Caching Suggestions with Immutable Audit Trail
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Customer teams are receiving Optimize suggestions (batching size increases, prefix/KV cache settings) but lack a safe, observable way to preview, apply, and roll back runtime configuration changes. Current console cards show recommendations but applying them is a manual multi-step process with limited auditability, leading to hesitation and missed savings.

Goal: Ship a safe-apply experience in the Optimize Console that: (1) surfaces batching/caching suggestions as actional cards with clear cost + latency tradeoffs, (2) provides an interactive diff preview of runtime config changes before apply, (3) executes staged applies with automatic sandbox canaries and gradual rollouts, and (4) records an immutable, searchable apply history and audit trail with snapshotted configs and rollback buttons.

Scope: UI cards (recommendation + reason + risk score + expected delta), a diff preview modal showing pre/post config and estimated impact, backend apply API with sandbox and canary stages, an apply history timeline with immutable entries (who/when/what), rollback operation that produces a new apply entry, telemetry for cost/latency regressions, and RBAC gating for enterprise tenants. Not in scope: autosuggestion auto-apply without user confirmation, model re-training, and billing system changes beyond cost estimate surface area.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards display estimated cost delta, expected latency delta, and a risk score computed from workload variance and model sensitivity.
Diff preview modal shows per-field pre/post config, highlights changed parameters (batch_size, max_input_len, cache_ttl_seconds, cache_key_strategy), and allows inline comments before apply.
Apply flow supports: sandbox apply (no production traffic), canary rollout (percentage-based), and full rollout with immediate fallback to previous snapshot on regression detection.
Every apply (sandbox/canary/full/rollback) creates an immutable audit entry with timestamp, actor, diff snapshot, related PR/notes link, and telemetry snapshot of baseline metrics.
Audit timeline is searchable by actor, recommendation id, and time range and exposes a one-click revert that creates a new apply entry reversing the previous config.
Backend endpoints return 202 for staged applies and include an operation id; operation status is surfaced in the UI until terminal (succeeded/failed/rolled_back).
E2E tests cover UI flows, API contract, and a simulated regression detection that triggers automatic rollback during canary.
RBAC: Only users with 'optimize.apply' permission can execute production applies; sandbox applies available to broader roles.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal beta — Redwood platform + 3 customer pilots, sandbox-only (1 week).
Phase 2: Canary enabled — gradual canary rollout for pilot tenants; monitor latency/cost and auto-rollback thresholds (2 weeks).
Phase 3: Graduated GA — opt-in for all tenants with RBAC; default to suggestion-only for new customers (1 week).
Rollback policy: automatic rollback when cost per token increases > 5% or 95th latency regresses beyond SLO by 20% during canary window.
